description: Transfer pump lifting cold water from the ground tanks up the riser to the roof tanks, 2 duty + 1 standby (plant-design basis, review A14).

impeller_wear.description: Worn impeller: the pump develops less head at the same speed.

head_fraction.description: Head delivered as a fraction of the healthy curve.

trip.description: Motor or drive trips; the pump stops and ignores its command until reset.

name: Cold-water transfer pump

dp_nominal.description: Pump head at nominal flow (the curve is scaled from it).

speed.description: Speed command as a fraction of full speed.

v_trip_pu.description: Undervoltage trip: the drive stops below this supply voltage.
